task.title: governed promotion pipeline rejects its own generated __pycache__, blocking all automated dev-root sync

scope.owned_layer: Immutable supervisor candidate provisioning, governed launch environment, watchdog and status child-process inheritance, persistent supervisor Python argv, and their focused regression contracts.
not_changing: frontend, BFF, broker, trading, or capital behavior
composes_with: the existing sync-dev-root rollback-safe promotion transaction

incident.observed_behavior: Candidate-side provisioning imports promote_supervisor_runtime and supervisor_runtime_health before the first governed promotion cleanliness revalidation. Normal Python import caching creates ignored scripts/__pycache__ bytecode in the immutable candidate, and verify_working_tree_cleanliness then rejects that directory.

review_rejection.finding: python -B is interpreter-local; supervisor and worker status children could repopulate the immutable command root after launch because they did not inherit PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1.

secondary_observation.description: A separate 2026-08-06 retry aborted while treating a checkout with a gitfile .git as an immutable standalone runtime.
secondary_observation.scope_decision: Not reproduced or root-caused by this pycache repair. It requires a separately supervisor-dispatched task before any closure claim; no task id is invented in this worker lane.
secondary_observation.preserved_guard: The repaired sync and deploy paths continue to materialize standalone command-runtimes/<40-hex> clones with real .git directories and do not weaken the candidate Git-directory identity guard.

repair.strategy: Prevent bytecode writes at every candidate-side entrypoint, make PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 part of the governed and watchdog launch environment so descendants inherit it, and retain Python -B in config-owned argv as belt-and-braces protection.
controls: provision_live_supervisor_config disables bytecode before importing the promotion verifier
promote-supervisor-runtime.sh invokes both discover and promote modes with python3 -B
sync-dev-root and nonprod deployment invoke candidate provisioning with python3 -B
the governed launch contract requires PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 and binds it into the launched process identity whenever the config-owned argv contains -B
a legacy incumbent without -B remains capturable once so config drift can move it through the existing governed promotion transaction
watchdog launches and restarts export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 to the supervisor and every descendant
supervisor status subprocess context sets PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 for recover, dispatch, and batch mutations
ai-status.sh exports PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 before any helper interpreter and invokes ai_status.py with -B
promotion config variants insert -B for legacy live configs and do so idempotently
verify_working_tree_cleanliness remains unchanged and continues rejecting ignored directories
repair.security_decision: Do not allowlist __pycache__ or .pyc. Untracked executable bytecode remains forbidden in an immutable command runtime.

commands.command: bash -n scripts/ai-status.sh scripts/run-supervisor-watchdog.sh scripts/promote-supervisor-runtime.sh scripts/sync-dev-root.sh scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh

exploratory_full_file_run.task_failure_disposition: One legacy-incumbent test fixture assumed the repaired environment even though its argv intentionally lacked -B; the fixture was corrected and the complete 284-test promotion/deploy suite then passed.
pre_existing_failures_outside_scope: two status-command mutation fixtures omit the exact process generation now required by ai_status.py
two runtime-config tests still expect Antigravity2 disabled while current .orchestrator/config.json enables it

required_proof: the task PR is merged into dev
sync-dev-root materializes the merged dev SHA as a standalone immutable runtime
the governed promotion transaction records outcome=promoted with three fresh successful loops
live config and supervisor process bind the promoted immutable command root, include Python -B, and expose PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 in the process identity
the promoted command runtime has no ignored __pycache__ or .pyc
the promoted SHA contains both PR #4582 and PR #4625

rollout_and_rollback.rollout: After protected merge, invoke the existing sync-dev-root governed handoff from the configured command root. The current /home/lupin/pantheon-ci-deploy/runtime/live-supervisor-mainroot-config.json supervisor_command lacks -B, so build_live_config will intentionally report config drift and the first run must migrate that legacy incumbent through the governed promotion transaction. Do not directly edit dev-root or signal the supervisor outside the transaction.
rollout_and_rollback.rollback: The existing promotion transaction retains the incumbent identity and config, terminates a failed candidate generation, reinstalls the rollback config, relaunches the incumbent, and requires fresh rollback loops before reporting rolled_back.
rollout_and_rollback.fail_closed: If candidate materialization, cleanliness, identity, config CAS, process launch, or post-launch loop verification fails, do not claim PR #4582/#4625 runtime promotion.
